```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(foreign)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
demo_2011 <- read.xport(here("data", "nhanes_demo_2011.xpt"))
demo_2013 <- read.xport(here("data", "nhanes_demo_2013.xpt"))
nhanes_fda <- readRDS(here("data", "nhanes_fda_with_r.rds"))

demo_combined <- bind_rows(demo_2011, demo_2013) %>%
  dplyr::select(SEQN, SDDSRVYR, WTINT2YR, WTMEC2YR, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA)

nhanes_final <- nhanes_fda %>%
  left_join(demo_combined, by = "SEQN") %>%
  mutate(STRAPSU = paste(SDMVSTRA, SDMVPSU, sep = "_"))

strapsu_summary <- nhanes_final %>%
  group_by(STRAPSU) %>%
  summarize(unique_participants = n_distinct(SEQN))

# View the result
hist(strapsu_summary$unique_participants, main = "Histogram of unique participants per PSU")
summary(strapsu_summary$unique_participants)

saveRDS(nhanes_final, file = here("data", "nhanes_with_demo.rds"))
```
